# Bundled frontend libraries

These files are included so noteBrain can run without internet access or a package manager.

- **CodeMirror** 5.58.3 — `codemirror/`; MIT license. Upstream: https://codemirror.net/
- **Marked** 4.0.19 — `marked/`; MIT license. Upstream: https://marked.js.org/
- **DOMPurify** 3.2.6 — `dompurify/`; Apache-2.0 / MPL-2.0. Upstream: https://github.com/cure53/DOMPurify
- **MathJax** 3.2.1 — `mathjax/es5/`; Apache-2.0. Upstream: https://www.mathjax.org/

The upstream URLs above are attribution/reference links only; the app does not request them at runtime. Preserve the bundled license notices when redistributing the application.
